title: BC Transmission Lines
name: bc-transmission-lines
description:
High voltage electrical transmission lines for distributing power throughout the province. Lines were derived from several data sources representing unique inventories: BC Hydro, Private, Independent Power Producers, and Terrain Resource Information Management (TRIM).

Voltage information is not currently available on the public version of this dataset as per publication agreement with BC Hydro.
purpose: To represent high voltage electrical transmission lines from various sources in one dataset for analytic, cartographic and emergency management purposes.
object_table_comments: High voltage electrical transmission lines for distributing power throughout the province. Lines were derived from several data sources representing unique inventories: BC Hydro, Private, Independent Power Producers, and Terrain Resource Information Management (TRIM).

details.column_comments: TRANSMISSION_LINE_ID is a system-generated unique identification number.
CIRCUIT_NAME is an identifier of the transmission line, as derived from BC Hydro transmission lines, e.g., 1L246.
CIRCUIT_DESCRIPTION is the description of the transmission line, in the form of an abbreviated origin to an abbreviated destination, e.g., MON - Monashee -> WGS - Whatshan.
VOLTAGE is the voltage (electric potential difference) of the transmission line measured in kilovolts (kV), e.g., 130.  Null values indicate that this information is not available.
OWNER is the legal owner and operator of the transmission line, i.e., BC Hydro, FortisBC, Unknown.
SOURCE_DATE is the date on which the data was captured, whether through digitization or loading from a digital input data source.
FEATURE_LENGTH_M is the system calculated length or perimeter of a geometry in meters.
SHAPE is the column used to reference the spatial coordinates defining the feature.
OBJECTID is a column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.
SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA is a binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.
